_meta.description: Synthetic sales transaction dataset for demonstration purposes. These are NOT actual company performance figures.

fields.sales_amount: Net revenue for this transaction (USD). Assumed to be net of discount already applied.
fields.unit_price: List price per unit before discount (USD)

_meta.revenue_definition: sales_amount is treated as net revenue (post-discount). Gross revenue can be estimated as quantity_sold * unit_price. The dataset does not include an order_id; product_id is reused across transactions and does NOT uniquely identify an order. Each row is treated as one independent transaction line.
warnings: This is SYNTHETIC data for demonstration only.
product_id values repeat across rows — they identify the product, not the order.
No unique transaction/order identifier exists in the source CSV.
unit_cost and unit_price are per-unit figures; do not sum them directly.
discount is a rate (0–1), not a monetary amount.
